name: memory-lens
description: Read-only view of what ai-memory injects and reads during a session

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: on: open the pane at session start and keep it open. off: never open it by itself; /memory-lens and /mem still toggle it. auto: open on a pending handoff, a last-session line or a memory write or handoff, and close after about 25 s idle (only where the pane can dock).

toastSeconds.title: Toast seconds
toastSeconds.description: How long a memory toast stays visible.

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description: on: ask the model for a short name/summary when a page has none. off: show stored text only.
